title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna;
  • Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia;
  • Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas;
  • Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política;
  • Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições;
  • Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento;
  • People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
  • Automação e IA aplicada ao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares);
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão.


Também é legal se você tiver:


  • Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes de startup;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.

title: Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - DBRE em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000 clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH.


Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estrutura de Cargos e Salários: Administrar e manter a estrutura de cargos e salários da organização, garantindo a atualização contínua de tabelas, faixas, políticas e critérios de movimentação interna;
  • Análises e Movimentações Salariais: Conduzir análises salariais para subsidiar decisões de promoções, enquadramentos e ajustes, propondo alternativas alinhadas às diretrizes de remuneração e ao orçamento da companhia;
  • Ciclos de Mérito e Calibração: Conduzir os ciclos anuais de mérito, promoções e calibração salarial, garantindo consistência, equidade e aderência às políticas internas;
  • Pesquisas Salariais e Inteligência de Mercado: Conduzir pesquisas de mercado e estudos comparativos, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a competitividade da remuneração e embasando propostas de revisão de política;
  • Descrições de Cargo: Manter e evoluir as descrições de cargo da organização, apoiando lideranças na definição clara de responsabilidades, requisitos e escopo das posições;
  • Remuneração Variável e Programas de Incentivo: Apoiar no desenho e revisão de políticas de Remuneração Variável (ICP, bônus, comissões) e programas de incentivo, contribuindo para a efetividade dos mecanismos de reconhecimento;
  • People Analytics e Dashboards: Desenvolver e manter indicadores de RH, estruturar bases de dados e construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos que transformem dados em insumos relevantes para a tomada de decisão;
  • Automação e IA aplicada ao RH: Apoiar na identificação, desenvolvimento e implementação de automações e soluções com Inteligência Artificial voltadas aos processos de RH, contribuindo para a evolução e escala da área;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Propor melhorias contínuas em práticas, políticas e processos de remuneração e gestão de dados, com visão sistêmica e foco em resultados.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Psicologia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em Remuneração, Estrutura de Cargos e Salários e análises organizacionais;
  • Domínio avançado de Excel e/ou Google Sheets;
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio ou similares);
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, identificar tendências e gerar insights para suporte à decisão.


Também é legal se você tiver:


  • Vivência com People Analytics e governança de dados de RH;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou ambientes de startup;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e aplicações práticas de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Experiência em modelos de trabalho remoto ou híbrido.

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.

  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Administrative Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.

Highlight Role of the Week!



Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-time Monthly Rates: $800 to $1,280 (20 hours per week)


Full-time Monthly Rates: $1,600 to $2,560 (40 hours per week)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated based on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position you apply for, as it will be based on the client's requested schedule. All our clients are in the U.S., and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, coordinating schedules, maintaining communication with internal and external teams, and managing tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to the job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Junior Technical Support Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Technical Support Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Customer Support Analyst (Technical Support)


About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join a global technology team supporting innovative digital products and platforms.

This is a long-term remote opportunity for professionals based in Brazil who enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working closely with product and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with technical curiosity and the ability to troubleshoot software-related issues.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer support inquiries.
  • Capture and document critical issue details within the ticketing system.
  • Troubleshoot software and platform-related issues through investigation and testing.
  • Guide customers through troubleshooting steps and identify whether issues are technical defects or user knowledge gaps.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the resolution process.
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to escalate and resolve complex issues.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes and knowledge base documentation.
  • Assist in monitoring service levels and support performance metrics.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend process or product improvements.


Required Qualifications

  • 1+ year of experience in Customer Support, Customer Service, Technical Support, Help Desk, Service Desk, or similar roles.
  • Experience working with ticketing systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and customer-friendly manner.
  • Experience supporting a high volume of customer inquiries.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Professional English communication skills (written and verbal).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS products or technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Intercom, or similar support tools.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineering or product teams.
  • Previous experience creating support documentation or knowledge base articles.
  • Leadership or customer service management experience is a plus.


What We're Looking For

  • Customer-first mindset.
  • Empathy and strong communication skills.
  • Curiosity and passion for technology.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Continuous learning mentality.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.


Work Environment

  • 100% Remote (Brazil)
  • Long-term project | PJ
  • International team environment
  • Schedule aligned with U.S. Central Time (CST)

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.
  • Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams.
  • Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions.


Engagement highlights:

  • Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries.
  • Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design.
  • Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior IT Performance & KPI Analyst para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de Tecnologia da Informação, em ambiente corporativo de grande porte.

Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e confiabilidade dos indicadores utilizados na gestão de performance de serviços de TI, atuando de forma estratégica na definição e evolução de métricas que suportem a tomada de decisão e a excelência operacional.

O papel exige forte interação com áreas técnicas, operações de TI, times de dados/BI e stakeholders de negócio, traduzindo demandas operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores mensuráveis, acionáveis e alinhados aos objetivos organizacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de performance de serviços de TI;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Definir conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise de KPIs;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo, qualidade e nível de serviço (SLAs/SLOs);
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação de indicadores junto às áreas técnicas e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na gestão e priorização do backlog de indicadores, considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de frameworks de governança de performance em TI;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de BI e dados para implementação e operacionalização das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando lideranças na tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior ou pós-graduação em Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Vivência na definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência em ambientes de TI, com interface entre áreas técnicas, operações e dados;
  • Capacidade de atuação tanto em nível estratégico quanto no detalhamento conceitual de indicadores;
  • Experiência com stakeholders e suporte à tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Desejáveis

  • Experiência em ambientes de Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) ou operações de serviços de TI;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.);
  • Experiência em Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de gestão de serviços (ITIL) e governança (COBIT);
  • Vivência com metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos ou de grande porte.


Diferenciais do perfil

  • Experiência prévia na estruturação de indicadores corporativos de TI;
  • Atuação em governança de métricas de performance e eficiência operacional;
  • Capacidade de conectar dados técnicos com impacto de negócio;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e orientado à melhoria contínua.



Sobre a empresa

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno

logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional


growth.

title: Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Analista Pleno de Parcerias Institucionais. Somos uma legaltech em crescimento acelerado - desenvolvemos tecnologia, IA e ferramentas de produtividade para advogados e departamentos jurídicos do Brasil.

Nesta posição, você será responsável pela gestão operacional das parcerias estratégicas da Jusfy, atuando diretamente com entidades como a Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil, universidades e associações. Você vai garantir que essas parcerias aconteçam de ponta a ponta - da estruturação ao acompanhamento - assegurando execução, relacionamento e resultado.

Você terá uma atuação organizada e analítica, conduzindo o onboarding de novos parceiros, mantendo o relacionamento institucional no dia a dia e atuando como ponte entre Parcerias e as áreas internas para garantir que cada iniciativa saia do papel.

Esta é uma posição para pessoas com perfil mão na massa, forte senso de organização e facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders institucionais, que gostam de estruturar processos e sustentar operações que crescem.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Apoiar operacionalmente a prospecção de novos parceiros institucionais, organizando pipeline, agendas, materiais e follow-ups de negociação.
  • Apoiar a formalização e documentação das parcerias, estruturando contrapartidas acordadas com cada parceiro.
  • Conduzir o onboarding operacional de parceiros, organizando kick-offs, cronogramas e planos de ação.
  • Mapear canais e oportunidades de divulgação e estruturar os fluxos de comunicação com parceiros.
  • Fazer o acompanhamento operacional das parcerias ativas, garantindo a execução das entregas acordadas.
  • Manter relacionamento recorrente com stakeholders institucionais e acompanhar indicadores e resultados.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e expansão das parcerias.
  • Atuar como ponte entre Parcerias, Marketing, Produto e Operações, garantindo alinhamento entre as áreas.
  • Apoiar a construção de materiais e apresentações institucionais.
  • Estruturar e manter controles, relatórios, indicadores e playbooks operacionais, garantindo previsibilidade à área.


O que buscamos:

  • Perfil organizado, executor e analítico, com forte senso de acompanhamento.
  • Boa comunicação institucional, verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de gerir múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com organização de projetos e processos.
  • Excel ou Google Sheets intermediário.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com parcerias institucionais ou relações institucionais.
  • Experiência com entidades, associações ou universidades.
  • Experiência em startups, SaaS ou tecnologia - preferencialmente legaltech.
  • Familiaridade com CRM e ferramentas de gestão.
  • Experiência com eventos ou ações institucionais.


PJ | Remoto


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível no valor de R$ 265,00
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados)
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Ambiente descontraído e inovador
  • Oportunidade de atuar em projetos com impacto real no crescimento da empresa


Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Quer fazer parte de uma das legaltechs que mais cresce no Brasil? Se candidate na posição.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Procurement Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Position Overview

This is not a traditional purchasing role.

We are looking for a procurement leader capable of building strategic relationships with manufacturers, distributors, fabricators, and suppliers across the building envelope industry.

The ideal candidate understands construction procurement, supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and supplier negotiations within industries such as:

  • Architectural Glass & Glazing
  • Curtain Wall Systems
  • Metal Fabrication
  • ACM & Metal Panel Systems
  • Building Envelope Products
  • Insulation Systems
  • Waterproofing & Air Barrier Systems
  • Fasteners & Specialty Construction Products

This individual will play a direct role in improving project profitability, strengthening supplier partnerships, and creating scalable procurement processes to support Longarone's next phase of growth.



Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy.
  • Negotiate national and international supplier agreements.
  • Establish long-term strategic partnerships with manufacturers and distributors.
  • Lead sourcing initiatives focused on cost reduction and supply chain optimization.
  • Collaborate with Estimators and Project Managers during budgeting and project planning.
  • Evaluate new suppliers, products, technologies, and market opportunities.
  • Monitor commodity pricing trends and market fluctuations.
  • Manage procurement forecasting and material planning.
  • Improve procurement systems, reporting, and purchasing controls.
  • Coordinate material purchasing, logistics, and delivery schedules.
  • Present monthly procurement performance reports to executive leadership.



Desired BackgroundRequired
  • 7+ years of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain experience.
  • Experience within construction, glazing, architectural glass, façade systems, building envelope, metal fabrication, or related industries.
  • Strong contract negotiation and supplier management experience.
  • Proven track record of generating measurable cost savings.
  • Ability to analyze pricing structures and supplier performance.
  • Fluent English communication skills.


Highly Preferred
  • Existing relationships with manufacturers and distributors in the façade, glazing, curtain wall, or architectural metals sectors.
  • Experience purchasing materials for commercial construction projects.
  • Knowledge of Passive House, high-performance building systems, and modern façade technologies.
  • Experience with ERP and procurement management software.


Success Metrics
  • Procurement Savings
  • Cost Avoidance
  • Supplier Reliability
  • Lead Time Reduction
  • Margin Improvement
  • Forecast Accuracy
  • Supply Chain Stability


Compensation

Competitive Base Salary + Performance Bonus

The selected candidate will participate in a Procurement Savings Incentive Program tied directly to measurable value creation through:

  • Supplier negotiations
  • Strategic sourcing
  • Cost reductions
  • Supply chain improvements
  • Margin enhancement initiatives

Top performers will have significant earning potential tied to their impact on company profitability.



Why Join Longarone?
  • Fully Remote Position
  • Direct Access to Executive Leadership
  • High Growth Environment
  • Opportunity to Build a World-Class Procurement Department
  • Performance-Based Compensation
  • Work on Landmark Building Envelope Projects Throughout the Northeast U.S.

Organizamos regularmente eventos da empresa para networking e formação de equipes com colegas.

title: Junior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Junior Writer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Junior Writer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.


Role Overview

As a Junior Writer, you will be responsible for adapting and localizing English content into portuguese - culturally relevant versions, ensuring narrative consistency, emotional depth, and audience engagement. You will work closely with editorial, production, and AI teams to refine scripts, monitor performance, and enhance content quality across the platform.


Key Responsibilities

1. Content Development & Adaptation

  • Review English show materials (audio/scripts) and prepare localization sheets and concept notes with strong cultural adaptation.
  • Adapt scripts using designated GenAI tools, ensuring proper structuring, tone, and inclusion of emotion tags where required.
  • Review and refine AI-generated translations to ensure alignment with editorial standards, cultural nuances, and narrative integrity.
  • Incorporate editorial and technical feedback to revise and deliver high-quality, polished scripts.
  • Deliver ~300 localized and AI-adapted scripts per month, adhering to timelines and quality benchmarks.


2. Quality Reviews & Continuous Improvement

  • Review published audio episodes and provide structured feedback on AI-generated adaptations.
  • Identify recurring issues in translation, tone, or storytelling and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze user comments and feedback to enhance content quality and relevance.


3. Production Support & Quality Assurance

  • Suggest suitable voice-over artists based on character and project requirements
  • Ensure produced content aligns with creative intent and quality standards
  • Conduct quality checks on production samples and provide actionable feedback to ensure “first-time-right” output.


4. Promotion Support

  • Develop concepts and draft scripts for promotional content (10–60 minutes) aligned with series positioning and storytelling goals


5. AI-Driven Editorial Innovation & Tool Adoption

  • Demonstrate hands-on usage of AI tools to enhance editorial workflows, script development, research, adaptation, and content optimization.
  • Apply strong editorial judgment while leveraging GenAI tools to ensure narrative quality, factual consistency, cultural sensitivity, and platform standards.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or related
  • Strong storytelling skills with an understanding of narrative structure, character development, and pacing.
  • Familiarity with AI-based writing or content adaptation tools is preferred
  • Experience in content localization, translation review, or scriptwriting is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across high-volume deliverables.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret user data and feedback.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced content production environment.

  • Boa comunicação institucional, verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de gerir múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Facilidade de relacionamento com stakeholders.
  • Experiência com organização de projetos e processos.

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.


OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives.   • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Apply Today

A Quadrante


Ao fazer parte do Grupo você terá a oportunidade de integrar um time jovem, dinâmico e ambicioso. Conhecimento prático em normas e procedimentos de segurança elétrica.

Experiência em subestações 69 kV e 138 kV;

Vivência com relés SEL, Siemens, ABB, Schneider, GE;

Experiência com SCADA, telecom e integração de sistemas.

title: Analista Jr Front Office (Investimentos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Jr Front Office (Investimentos) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Analista de Suporte N1 – Front Office (Capital Markets)

Contexto

Buscamos profissional para atuar no suporte de primeiro nível (N1) às aplicações de Front Office de uma grande instituição financeira, com foco em Mercado de Capitais / Renda Fixa . O profissional será responsável por garantir a estabilidade operacional dos sistemas utilizados pelas mesas de operações, atuando como ponto de contato direto entre traders, Middle Office e times de tecnologia.

Responsabilidades

  • Prestar suporte N1 às aplicações de renda fixa do Front Office.
  • Manter interação constante com traders e Middle Office para tratamento de incidentes e dúvidas operacionais.
  • Executar conciliações diárias (daily reconciliation) das operações e posições.
  • Identificar, analisar e escalar chamados para o suporte de N2 quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar e dar follow-up nos tickets , garantindo a resolução dentro do SLA.
  • Apoiar atividades de validação de dados (data validation) .
  • Participar de testes básicos (funcionais e de homologação dos sistemas).

Requisitos

  • Vivência em ambiente de Front Office (mesa de operações) .
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de vida das operações (trade lifecycle) e da interação entre Front e Middle Office .
  • Fundamentos de Renda Fixa, Títulos e Derivativos .
  • Conceitos de P&L, fluxo de caixa e apreçamento (valuation) .
  • Perfil de suporte N1 com domínio em Capital Markets .
  • Experiência hands-on em sistemas de trading (Bloomberg e/ou Murex) .
  • Sólidas habilidades de conciliação e gestão de stakeholders .
  • Inglês avançado para atender clientes internacionais

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Murex .
  • Habilidades em SQL e scripting (automação de rotinas).
  • Exposição a múltiplas classes de ativos (multi-asset) .
  • Visão de ITSM e mentalidade voltada à automação de processos .

title: Global Talent & Leadership Development Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Talent & Leadership Development Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pyxus / Alliance One International, headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina, USA is a leading global supplier of tobacco leaf. With operations in approximately 30 countries, we deliver high-quality, value-added products and services to customers in over 90 countries. As a trusted partner in the industry, we prioritize responsible sourcing, sustainability, and traceability. Our commitment to ethical practices and environmental stewardship is a cornerstone of our operations worldwide.


Key Responsibilities

  • Talent Reviews & Succession Planning

Collaborates in the design and implementation of the global Talent Management framework to ensure a strong and consistent leadership pipeline across the organization. Aligns Oracle systems with business needs and drives global adoption of talent practices. Facilitates annual Talent Reviews and calibration sessions, partners with Regional HR to identify critical roles, and develops succession plans for M4+ leadership positions. Monitors development progress and provides talent insights and metrics to support workforce planning and strategic decisions.

  • Learning & Development

Leads the global Learning & Development strategy aligned with business priorities and capability needs. Works closely with HR and business leaders to define learning priorities and deliver leadership, management, and professional development programs. Oversees LinkedIn Learning and Oracle Learning platforms, including governance, campaigns, user experience, and vendor management. Tracks participation, engagement, and career outcomes, using data, KPIs, and ROI analysis to continuously improve learning effectiveness.

  • Pyxus Academy Rotational Program

Leads the design, governance, and execution of the rotational program, partnering with business leaders and HR to identify opportunities and participants. Coordinates selection, development plans, and stakeholder alignment, while monitoring progress and outcomes to strengthen the internal talent pipeline through hands-on and cross-functional experiences.

  • Reporting & KPIs

Develops and tracks metrics to measure the efficiency and impact of talent and learning initiatives, using data-driven insights to improve processes.

  • Budget & Resource Management

Monitors budget adherence and manages contracts with external vendors to ensure effective and strategic use of resources.


Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Fluent English
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, HR or related field required
  • Relevant business operations and Human Resources experience
  • Experience in deploying Talent Reviews & Succession Planning, Learning and Development programs and rotational development initiatives
  • Strong change agility and proven ability to deal with ambiguity
  • Leadership experience or comparable leadership responsibility
  • Influencing diverse teams in a global organization without formal leadership
  • Strategic orientation and critical thinking skills with the ability to align and integrate HR programs toward a holistic global approach to localization and business applicability
  • Demonstrated success in driving and successfully completing HR projects and process improvements in a global workplace
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and collaborative skills across levels, with an ability to persuade and influence, and the ability to build enthusiasm and commitment
  • Highly flexible, agile, collaborative, and effective at leading and delivering business imperatives in a dynamic environment
  • Business acumen paired with a hands-on mentality and the ability to match business needs with HR deliverables
  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to integrate complex data into insights to create future-focused, high-impact people business strategies
  • Work experience in multiple HR roles and organizations (COE, HRBP, SS)
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressured, ambiguous work environment, paying close attention to detail and meeting business-driven deadlines
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to coordinate multiple activities and shift priorities meeting established deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to break down problems into manageable tasks and processes while challenging assumptions
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with extreme professionalism and discretion


Benefits

Profit-Sharing Program (PPR)

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Education and foreign language allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Meal Card

Corporate Time Off Days

Wellhub

Group Life Insurance


Applications are open until Jun 28, 2026.

This includes Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Race, Ethnicity, and Religion.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Project Manager with 5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives within software and technology organizations. This role is focused on driving multiple concurrent product transition, migration, and implementation projects while coordinating stakeholders across Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, and Implementation teams.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments, excels at managing competing priorities, and can serve as the central point of coordination across numerous workstreams. You will act as the organizational \"control tower,\" ensuring critical initiatives stay on track, dependencies are identified early, risks are mitigated, and teams remain aligned toward shared objectives.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the central coordinator for 15 concurrent projects, including product transitions, implementation initiatives, and product enhancements
  • Drive cross-functional programs involving Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, Operations, Training, and Implementation teams
  • Develop and maintain program-level roadmaps, timelines, and dependency tracking
  • Ensure legacy product retirement initiatives remain on schedule and aligned with business objectives
  • Coordinate customer transition activities, including internal readiness, legal requirements, implementation planning, and operational processes
  • Partner with IT and Engineering teams to ensure systems, infrastructure, and technical requirements are properly aligned
  • Work closely with Legal and Operations teams to support product migrations, compliance requirements, notifications, and transition planning
  • Track and manage action items across multiple stakeholders and departments
  • Facilitate prioritization discussions and ensure resources remain focused on the highest-impact initiatives
  • Proactively identify project risks and drive resolution before they impact delivery timelines
  • Provide executive-level visibility into program status, blockers, dependencies, and milestones
  • Support implementation and rollout planning to ensure successful adoption of new products and services
  • Collaborate with Scrum Masters, Product Managers, and Engineering teams while maintaining a broader program-level perspective
  • Establish and improve processes for managing large-scale, cross-functional initiatives
  • Drive accountability across teams and ensure commitments are completed on schedule


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in Program Management, Technical Program Management, Project Management, or Product Operations roles
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects in software or technology-focused organizations
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple business functions and departments
  • Ability to identify gaps, dependencies, risks, and process improvements across complex initiatives
  • Strong experience facilitating cross-functional collaboration and driving execution
  • Experience working with software development, product management, and engineering organizations
  • Technical acumen with a solid understanding of software development, infrastructure, and technology concepts
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and maintain accountability across teams
  • Experience operating in fast-paced environments with competing priorities and evolving requirements


Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing product migrations, software implementations, or legacy system retirement programs
  • Experience using Kanban-based project management methodologies
  • Experience working with Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Finance, and Operations teams
  • Background in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology-driven organizations
  • Experience with portfolio management, program governance, or PMO functions
  • Familiarity with Agile development environments
  • Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms
  • Experience supporting organizational change management initiatives
  • Experience working in highly cross-functional, matrixed environments


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions. Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Develop and execute Longarone's procurement strategy.
