title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Coordinador de Planeamiento Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordinador de Planeamiento Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento:


Coordinador de Planeamiento y Demanda


¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?


  • Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas.
  • Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado.
  • Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en post de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento.
  • Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa.
  • Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro.
  • Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto.
  • Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente.
  • Velar por el Working Capital de la compañía a través de la administración de los inventarios de PT, MP y Repuestos.
  • Contribuir y velar por el buen clima laboral, coordinando y participando en las diferentes actividades que se desarrollen en coordinación con las otras jefaturas de la empresa.
  • Cumplir con las políticas y lineamientos de la empresa, del sistema integrado de gestión, política de las 5S, el RIT y el código de ética, así como del marco normativo del gobierno con la finalidad de contribuir con el desarrollo óptimo y adecuado de las diferentes actividades de la organización.


¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?


  • Titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.
  • Contar con 3 años de experiencia viendo procesos S&OP y manejo de presupuesto. (Indispensable)
  • Conocimiento en SAP y Office (Indispensable).
  • Nivel de inglés Intermedio/avanzado (Deseable).
  • Conocimientos en gestión de procesos, gestión por competencia y gestión al cambio.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.

Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.

Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who are we?


We’re a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.

We’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team.

Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.

You can see more about our storyjourney here!


We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures.


Safety isn’t just a department, it’s a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use.

We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance.



The Role

An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform.


You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards.


As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
  • Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery.
  • Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage.
  • Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments.
  • Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities.
  • Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.”
  • Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs.
  • Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models.
  • Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them.
  • Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required!
  • Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.


Perks & Benefits:

37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.

End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr Cloud Technical Architect (Observabilidade) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Função: Sr Cloud Technical Architect (Observabilidade)

Your day at NTT DATA


A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!


Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan

  • Entender requisitos de negócios do cliente;

  • Apoiar no planejamento de esforços para implementação (dimensionamento de horas);
  • Compartilhar conhecimento com outros times;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos produtos e serviços;
  • Participar de definições de tecnologia junto a clientes internos e externos;
  • Ser ponto focal de demandas técnicas que necessitem de direcionamento;
  • Priorização de demandas urgentes;
  • Ter viés de inovação e novas soluções disponíveis no mercado.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Conhecimentos consolidados nas soluções da Datadog, incluindo experiencia hands-on na execução de PoVs/PoCs;
  • Conhecimentos avançados nas plataformas de APM (Application Performance Manager);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em ELK Stack;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Grafana;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Splunk Observability;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em plataformas de NPM (Network Performance Manager).

Como você pode se destacar?

  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimento avançado da plataforma de APM Cisco AppDynamics;
  • Conhecimento avançado da plataforma Cisco Thousandeyes;
  • Conhecimento avançado da Stack ELK - Elasticsearch, Logstash e Kibana

  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.

Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.

Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who are we?


We’re a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.

We’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team.

Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.

You can see more about our storyjourney here!


We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures.


Safety isn’t just a department, it’s a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use.

We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance.



The Role

An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform.


You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards.


As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations.   • Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments.
  • Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities.
  • Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.”

  • Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required!
  • Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.

37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.

End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Analist de Projetos/Delivery Operations Analyst para coordenar a operação ponta-a-ponta do nosso portfólio de projetos e iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia.

Você será responsável por garantir que projetos saiam do conceito, passem por discovery, atravessem ciclos de sprint e cheguem em produção com qualidade, previsibilidade e visibilidade total para o negócio. Trabalhará lado-a-lado com executivos, PO, Solution Architect, Designer e time de desenvolvimento, operando um modelo híbrido Water-Scrum-Fall com cadência de sprints quinzenais.

É uma oportunidade para nos ajudar a desenhar e construir nosso processo de delivery, tendo voz ativa na evolução dele. Terá contato direto com a liderança, decisões rápidas e espaço real para impacto.

Buscamos uma pessoa organizada e orientada a entrega e com excelente comunicação.


Formato: 100% home office.

Necessário Inglês B2/C1 - Terá contato diário com times internacionais

Atuará no fuso horário -2h/-1h em relação ao horário de Brasília/DF


uais serão suas responsabilidades?


Governança e cadência de delivery

  • Orientar a operação do portfólio de projetos (discovery, build, sprints, releases, go-live, closure).
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos gates formais do processo (Sign-Off de requisitos, transição Water→Agile, aprovação de Go-Live, encerramento).
  • Conduzir as cerimônias do ciclo de sprint: Daily Standup, Sprint Review com Retrospectiva, Pre-Planning de capacity e Planning.
  • Manter cronogramas, dependências e owners atualizados; identificar e escalar riscos, gargalos e desvios proativamente.
  • Identificar quando uma Release está pronta para War Room e disparar o processo de validação integrada.
  • Coordenar UATs com Key Users e PO; garantir que bugs de UAT entrem no fluxo regular da próxima sprint.
  • Coordenar o Go-Live em ambiente de produção em parceria com SA e PO.
  • Liderar Hypercare pós Go-Live (2-4 semanas) e a transição formal para modo manutenção.
  • Conduzir Project Closure: métricas finais, lessons learned, comunicação executiva.
  • Conduzir a reunião semanal de Projects Follow-up com a liderança de TI, chegando com dashboard atualizado e propostas para riscos/decisões pendentes
  • Definir, manter e evoluir KPIs de delivery (velocity, % done, prazo realizado vs planejado, bugs em produção, SLA de hypercare)
  • Produzir status reports executivos para sponsors e stakeholders de negócio
  • Garantir comunicação clara, constante e estruturada entre TI e business


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência prévia coordenando projetos de tecnologia, squads ou times de delivery
  • Experiência prática com Scrum/Agile e com modelos híbridos/Waterfall
  • Experiência operacional com Jira (boards, workflows, relatórios) ou ferramenta equivalente
  • Excel intermediário a avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, dashboards)
  • Experiência produzindo reportes executivos e apresentações em PowerPoint
  • Experiência acompanhando KPIs e dashboards operacionais
  • Inglês avançado (B2/C1) — leitura técnica e reuniões com stakeholders globais


Como você pode se destacar?

  • Experiência em PMO, Delivery Management, Customer Success ou Operations em ambiente de tecnologia
  • Familiaridade com modelos Water-Scrum-Fall ou frameworks híbridos
  • Experiência com Power BI, Jira Analytics ou outras ferramentas de visualização
  • Experiência com automações no Jira (regras, integrações, scripts)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas a produtividade (Copilot, ChatGPT, automações)


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: User Researcher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para User Researcher em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior User Researcher

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


We’re looking for a driven and inspiring Senior User Researcher to join our global team, to help businesses shape their strategy and bring to life products that win people’s hearts. You will have a chance to work across diverse industries and product lifecycles, partnering with some of the world’s most recognisable brands.

Bringing an experimental yet rigorous mindset, you will define the unknowns, challenge assumptions, and collaborate with stakeholders at every level to disrupt markets with new products or transform existing experiences, through customer-driven evidence.


Responsibilities:

  • Own user research stream on the project: from spotting opportunities through planning, user recruitment and execution, to helping the team prioritise and embed insight into the product.
  • Set up and manage user research process throughout discovery and delivery of a project, ensuring it fits seamlessly within agile workflows.
  • Conduct various types of research, depending on the context: exploratory, assessment, evaluative, quantitative and qualitative.
  • Collaborate with the design and product team to action the insights and embed them into strategy, roadmap and solutions.
  • Participate in enhancing the practice with the wider user research team: contribute to guidelines, knowledge sharings, supporting people who do research.
  • Consult presale teams on user research approaches for potential new projects, if needed.


Required skills and experience:

  • Well-versed in core user research methods and able to execute them independently; this is the minimum expectation for the role before we look at advanced skills.
  • An experimental mindset combined with rigour: you are comfortable trying new tools and approaches, while knowing the true value of user research and guardrails.
  • Proven experience assessing and validating early product concepts with various methods, not only interviews.
  • Skilled in defining customer segmentation across various markets.
  • Experience with recruiting participants for research.
  • A star facilitator, known for leading workshops, design sprints, and co-creation sessions that spark creativity and build alignment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and the drive to move work forward without waiting to be asked. You thrive on minimal direction: we’ll support you, but we want you to be the one moving things forward.
  • Stellar communication: advising, negotiating, and effectively collaborating with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Able to connect the dots and create compelling, evidence-led narratives that impact the way stakeholders think, build empathy for customers and guide product decisions.
  • Strong at managing priorities and deadlines: ready to stay organised and adaptable when things get busy or change direction.
  • Well-versed in tools that streamline research: Maze, Dovetail or similar tools for synthesis, repositories, unmoderated testing etc.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in a standalone user research role.


Nice to have:

  • Experience in Healthcare and/or Banking
  • Data analytics experience
  • Design experience
  • Experience in pre-sale activities


What’s in it for you?

  • The projects are various, which gives you a lot of new experiences and challenges. We work with start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise clients across different industries.
  • Ability to experiment with new approaches in product that incorporate AI tools, where it is appropriate
  • Work on projects for big global brands
  • Exposure to different geographies
  • Support and close collaboration with a cross-discipline team of Design, Product, BA and technical practitioners
  • Competitive salary depending on your skills and experience.
  • Constant development of your skills with the help of a knowledgeable product community: knowledge-sharing events and mentorship practices.
  • Regular support of your research leader and mentor.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (South & Central America, US Working Hours)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


Role Overview

As a Senior Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

Bringing an experimental yet rigorous mindset, you will define the unknowns, challenge assumptions, and collaborate with stakeholders at every level to disrupt markets with new products or transform existing experiences, through customer-driven evidence.


Responsibilities:

  • Own user research stream on the project: from spotting opportunities through planning, user recruitment and execution, to helping the team prioritise and embed insight into the product.
  • Set up and manage user research process throughout discovery and delivery of a project, ensuring it fits seamlessly within agile workflows.
  • Conduct various types of research, depending on the context: exploratory, assessment, evaluative, quantitative and qualitative.
  • Collaborate with the design and product team to action the insights and embed them into strategy, roadmap and solutions.
  • Participate in enhancing the practice with the wider user research team: contribute to guidelines, knowledge sharings, supporting people who do research.
  • Consult presale teams on user research approaches for potential new projects, if needed.


Required skills and experience:

  • Well-versed in core user research methods and able to execute them independently; this is the minimum expectation for the role before we look at advanced skills.
  • An experimental mindset combined with rigour: you are comfortable trying new tools and approaches, while knowing the true value of user research and guardrails.
  • Proven experience assessing and validating early product concepts with various methods, not only interviews.
  • Skilled in defining customer segmentation across various markets.
  • Experience with recruiting participants for research.
  • A star facilitator, known for leading workshops, design sprints, and co-creation sessions that spark creativity and build alignment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and the drive to move work forward without waiting to be asked. You thrive on minimal direction: we’ll support you, but we want you to be the one moving things forward.
  • Stellar communication: advising, negotiating, and effectively collaborating with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Able to connect the dots and create compelling, evidence-led narratives that impact the way stakeholders think, build empathy for customers and guide product decisions.
  • Strong at managing priorities and deadlines: ready to stay organised and adaptable when things get busy or change direction.
  • Well-versed in tools that streamline research: Maze, Dovetail or similar tools for synthesis, repositories, unmoderated testing etc.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in a standalone user research role.


Nice to have:

  • Experience in Healthcare and/or Banking
  • Data analytics experience
  • Design experience
  • Experience in pre-sale activities


What’s in it for you?

  • The projects are various, which gives you a lot of new experiences and challenges. We work with start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise clients across different industries.
  • Ability to experiment with new approaches in product that incorporate AI tools, where it is appropriate
  • Work on projects for big global brands
  • Exposure to different geographies
  • Support and close collaboration with a cross-discipline team of Design, Product, BA and technical practitioners
  • Competitive salary depending on your skills and experience.
  • Constant development of your skills with the help of a knowledgeable product community: knowledge-sharing events and mentorship practices.
  • Regular support of your research leader and mentor.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (South & Central America, US Working Hours)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


Role Overview

As a Senior Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

Weekly

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Resolve collection issues

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Review the chart of accounts

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

title: Consultor Comercial - Equipamentos Médicos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor Comercial - Equipamentos Médicos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. Formada em 2018 pela combinação da Essilor e da Luxottica, nossa empresa combina dois séculos de inovação e esforço humano para elevar o cuidado com a visão e a experiência do consumidor ao seu redor. Estamos em busca de um novo colaborador(a) para fazer parte da nossa equipe como Consultor Técnico Comercial - Instrumentos


Responsabilidades da posição:


  • Garantir o atingimento do budget de vendas da sua região de atuação.
  • Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes, incluindo pós-venda.
  • Prospectar novos clientes com base em mapeamento, inteligência de mercado e leads.Apresentar ao mercado portfólio e lançamentos com embasamento técnico e científico.
  • Identificar, analisar e priorizar oportunidades de negócio com foco em faturamento.
  • Executar suas atividades com visão analítica e estratégica, demonstrando iniciativa, senso de responsabilidade e proatividade, de modo a orientar as melhores escolhas, decisões e priorizações, assegurando a entrega consistente de resultados.
  • Conduzir negociações até a conclusão do fatuamento, fechamento de contratos e ações de fidelização.
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamento contínuo com clientes e com toda rede comercial das outras divisões da empresa e parceiros de negócios.
  • Manter presença ativa e recorrente no mercado, identificando oportunidades de negócios, dores e necessidades dos clientes, apresentado-os soluções.
  • Elaborar previsões de vendas (forecast) com base em análises de mercado e performance.
  • Criar planos de ação para mitigação de riscos e reversão de cenários desfavoráveis.
  • Planejar e executar roteiro de visitas, com registro em sistema.Implementar estratégias de marketing e ações promocionais.
  • Gerir investimentos comerciais, assegurando retorno positivo.
  • Desenvolver projetos e soluções customizadas conforme necessidades dos clientes.
  • Assegurar frequência, sequência e qualidade das interações comerciais.
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos fluxos e processos entre clientes e empresa.
  • Promover sinergia, forte colaboração e desempenhar papeis de responsabilidade em temas que envolvem as mais diversas área de suporte.
  • Atuar em diversas iniciativas de geração de demanda e fortalecimento da marca.
  • Participar de feiras e eventos, treinamentos, cursos e ações comerciais diversas no mercado, que tenham potencial para realização de negócios.


Qualificações da posição:

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia, Publicidade e Propaganda, Economia ou correlatas;
  • Experiência comercial e vendas consultivas;
  • Forte habilidade de negociação e influência;Excelente comunicação verbal e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado para resultados;
  • Capacidade de acompanhamento e desenvolvimento de clientes;
  • Organização e autonomia na gestão do território;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes;


A EssilorLuxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PCD's.


Faça parte da nossa empresa e ajude a projetar o futuro da saúde visual. Enxergue o seu #FutureInSight com a EssilorLuxottica. Nós olhamos para o futuro!

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: 12 Month Contract

Location: Brazil, Fully Remote

Rate: $1,659 BRL R$/month - $3,316 BRL R$/month




JOB DESCRIPTION

Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy.


Day to Day Responsibilities

Accurately label machine learning data through various methods to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines.

Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality.

Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE


Bachelor’s Degree. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.g., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities).

C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency.

3-4 months of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred)

Proficiency in reading comprehension and possessive of strong writing skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex and diverse texts.

Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources.

Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team.

Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.


NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Experience w RLHF (Reinforcement Learning Human Feedback)

Multiple Language proficiency

Experience with multi modal data annotation (Text, Image, Video)

QA or QC experience

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Consultor (a) SAP Success Factors LMS (Learning)

Make this the place where you grow!


Na NTT DATA Business Solutions, impulsionamos a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e além, impulsionados por uma equipe global e mais de 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 nações em mais de 30 países. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas e para suas pessoas.

Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA atende 75% da Fortune Global 100 e, com especialistas em mais de 70 países, com novas soluções que incentivam a experimentação e reconhecem trabalhos excelentes.


Sobre a vaga


Você atuará em um projeto estratégico dentro de uma empresa multinacional de grande porte do setor industrial, reconhecida globalmente por sua atuação em engenharia, automação e soluções de energia.


A organização possui operações complexas e distribuídas internacionalmente, com forte foco em inovação, eficiência operacional e desenvolvimento contínuo de talentos, tornando o Learning Management System (LMS) um pilar essencial para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


  • Atuar como Consultor SAP SuccessFactors LMS em projetos de implementação e/ou sustentação
  • Levantar e analisar requisitos de negócio junto às áreas de RH e treinamento
  • Configurar e parametrizar o módulo SF Learning (LMS)
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar:
  • Currículos (Learning Paths)
  • Itens de treinamento
  • Programas de certificação
  • Garantir a execução de treinamentos obrigatórios (compliance)
  • Apoiar integrações com outros módulos do SuccessFactors (ex: Employee Central)
  • Atuar na gestão de conteúdos e plataformas de aprendizado
  • Suportar testes, validações e deploys
  • Participar de projetos globais e rollout de soluções
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SAP SuccessFactors LMS (Learning)
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou rollout LMS
  • Conhecimento funcional e de configuração do módulo
  • Experiência com: Gestão de treinamentos corporativos; Compliance e certificações
  • Certificação em SAP SuccessFactors Learning


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes industriais ou empresas de grande porte
  • Conhecimento em integrações (EC, SSO, conteúdo externo)
  • Experiência em projetos de migração (SAP HCM → SuccessFactors)
  • Vivência com grandes volumes de usuários
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado (ambiente global)


Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

Híbrido ou Remoto: Preferência para residentes de São Paulo, Santa Catarina e Curitiba.


Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de alemão em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga para Professora de Alemão (REMOTO)


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professora de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Ser Professora : Estamos em busca de professoras para integrar o corpo docente do Instituto Stephanie Lich.


  • Disponibilidade: Ampla disponibilidade de horários, especialmente no período noturno, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio de nossas redes sociais, ações de marketing e parcerias.


  • Experiência e Flexibilidade: Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.


  • Habilidades Tecnológicas: Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.
